gold_source_registry.behavior_scope: source-backed compact behavior contract with atomic behavior units
gold_source_registry.no_id_stable_key: source location + normalized source fact text

traceability.behavior_coverage: Explicit-ID declaration coverage remains primary when available; conservative Semantic Source Unit coverage is a separate no-ID mode.
traceability.no_id_explicit_coverage_semantics: N/A; numeric coverage/missing counts are null and evaluation state is separate
traceability.word_json_provenance_consistency: Canonical/Review JSON remains provenance truth. V0.82 retains V0.81 ownership cleanup and adds additive integrated SYS/SWE/native projections from one finalized verification bundle.
traceability.semantic_source_classifier_ground_truth_: not claimed without human-labelled Gold units
traceability.no_id_provenance_completion: Eligible no-ID items require Semantic Source Unit + exact Source-backed Atomic Behavior; pending items retain behavior or Source Fact.
traceability.source_table_fact_join_policy: linked semantic unit or exact identifier overlap; numeric coincidence alone is insufficient
traceability.ordered_list_marker_policy: Ordered-list recognition is source-kind/context aware; table cells are not list-split by default, and decimal/version/date/specification literals must be preserved.
traceability.missing_owned_fragment_backfill: Only Source-owned fragments materially matching the requirement and not represented by existing atomic behaviors may be backfilled.
traceability.composite_behavior_fragmentation: Non-table composite prose may be conservatively decomposed into behavior-level Source Fact Fragments; ownership is matched against Canonical behavior content rather than broad whole-paragraph evidence.
traceability.fragment_ownership_allocation_rule: A Source Fact Fragment must not carry conflicting allocation/verification-domain claims across SRS; distinct behaviors require distinct fragment identity or ownership correction.
traceability.positive_software_allocation_gate: V0.82 retains explicit/review-required inferred software candidate allocation and Source-backed executable action recognition, while trigger-only signal/PIN/voltage/CAN-LIN/B+/wake conditions are not software-allocation evidence by themselves.
traceability.software_eligibility_semantics: Controller/ECU actor + literal executable software-like Source behavior may be SW_BEHAVIOR_INFERRED_REVIEW_REQUIRED unless high-confidence non-SW domain applies. Inference is separate from explicit SW allocation evidence and remains release-review required.
traceability.raw_source_literal_preservation: Raw excerpt preserves detached closing punctuation; display normalization is separate.
traceability.provenance_audit: single structured Source-fact token stream + exact multi-fragment critical Fact Fragment ownership union with token-to-fragment evidence
traceability.critical_fragment_completion: V0.80 retains Source-bounded exact-cited provenance completion and adds high-confidence native-domain Canonical recovery; no facts are created outside literal Source evidence.
traceability.semantic_disposition: REVIEW_NEEDED remains OPEN/non-terminal until linked or explicitly dispositioned
traceability.shared_fragment_disambiguation: Clear non-critical dominant-parent leakage may be removed; ambiguous sharing remains SHARED_REVIEW_REQUIRED; critical overlap claimed by the Canonical is retained.
traceability.unanalyzed_visual_gap: Only when requirement already declares visual dependency and no Vision evidence exists; no visual semantics inferred
traceability.engineering_token_boundary: ASCII alnum/underscore lookarounds preserve Source identifiers/timing/retry literals adjacent to Korean particles/prose; no token is inferred beyond the literal.
traceability.shared_critical_fragment_retention: Dominant-parent cleanup must preserve a claimant when the exact shared Fragment contains a critical signal/timing/hex/retry token asserted by that claimant Canonical behavior.
traceability.inferred_software_release_gate: Artifact Readiness / Official Release remain REVIEW_REQUIRED until human allocation review.
traceability.source_bounded_behavior_completion: High-similarity literal behavior clauses may gain the minimum missing Fragment only within cited Source locations; adjacent Paragraph continuation is ±1 with stricter evidence.
traceability.mixed_domain_main_swe1_scope: Main SWE.1 isolates excluded pending/non-SWE.1 facts across requirement text, trigger, behavior, preconditions, output and acceptance/verification fields; full Canonical truth remains in Review/Audit context.
traceability.child_intent_representation_single_truth: DEFERRED/REVIEW_REQUIRED Child Intent disposition overrides broad lexical represented-in-TC flags.
traceability.hex_fact_token_normalization: Hex literals are compared case-insensitively for provenance/ownership (e.g. 0X0 == 0x0) while original Source spelling is preserved.
traceability.shared_fragment_contextual_allocation: When one physical Source Fact Fragment is legitimately claimed by parents with divergent allocation domains, V0.78 preserves the physical fragment and creates deterministic SRC-FRAGCTX-* per-parent aliases with contextual_alias_of backlinks.
traceability.explicit_cited_non_sw_trace_completion: Exact cited location + high-confidence non-SW classification + material overlap may complete provenance linkage only; it never changes allocation or invents a requirement fact.
traceability.human_policy_cross_version_persistence: External local registry + package seed; local decision wins over seed.
traceability.review_required_main_preservation: Eligible + Review Needed requirements remain visible in the Main Requirement Specification with explicit human-decision status; visibility is not approval.

engineering_e2e.ownership_hardening: Dominant Semantic ownership cleanup precedes fragment containment; allocation/projection is recomputed afterward.

known_limits: The bundled MLM Gold Contract is a compact behavior contract, not the full V0.46 Review Package.
The bundled confidential MLM Source is not included; Source SHA selects the compact contract.
Semantic Source Unit coverage is conservative; every eligible unit gets a disposition, but classifier precision/recall is not claimed without a human-labelled Gold unit set.
Allocation is a conservative review aid, not automatic ASPICE responsibility approval; ambiguous system behavior remains Review Needed.
A Cross-Document source is not automatically registered as Gold until a human-approved baseline is created.
Actual Missing behaviors remain release-blocking when explicit-ID coverage is applicable and a missing behavior is confirmed.
Numeric source literals with ambiguous relation are preserved rather than normalized into an invented comparator; human clarification may still be required.
Dedicated Timing/State/Variant TCs are not invented solely to raise intent coverage when source test evidence is insufficient.
GUI appearance/QFileSystemWatcher behavior requires Windows runtime confirmation.
Live H-Chat and direct-provider evaluation remain environment/policy dependent and were not exercised in this build environment.
Automatic unsupported-generation precheck is bounded and does not prove zero hallucination.
No-ID concrete SWE.6 generation is intentionally deferred when Semantic Source Unit / Atomic Behavior provenance is incomplete.
SWE.6 intent coverage is informative; deferred intents require reason codes and must not be converted to concrete tests by inventing missing source data.
Source-backed child intents improve auditability but do not mechanically force one concrete TC per atomic behavior.
Interface configuration facts remain pending allocation unless source-backed software responsibility is explicit.
SWE.6-specific export audit checks structural preservation and the actual Excel handoff, but does not prove physical bench executability without project-specific test environment evidence.
Cross-domain fact-level allocation preserves the parent bundle and does not automatically split SRS; human review may still choose later separation.
Child-intent status is an audit disposition, not proof of physical bench observability without project-specific instrumentation/test-environment evidence.
DERIVED verification-method candidates are engineering suggestions and must not be interpreted as Source requirements.
Allocation-pending deferred intent governance is auditable, but software responsibility remains a human/architecture allocation decision.
Source Table Fact auto-use requires HIGH-confidence semantic-unit or exact-identifier linkage; ambiguous multi-value rows remain Review/N/A/Deferred.
Repeated Explicit-ID Missing recovery requires at least two repeat-equivalent Missing declarations; single-occurrence Missing remains human-review blocking.
REPRESENTED_IN_GENERIC_TC does not imply independent observability or independent test coverage.

The no-ID [시스템사양서] same-source Gold contract is not bundled because an explicitly approved Gold contract was not supplied; register a human-approved package with [Gold Source 추가] before expecting a release regression PASS.

V0.67 generic regression validates fragment-to-child trace, minimum ownership, mixed-domain TC scope and automated-evaluation file/governance behavior, but real reference sources must be rerun locally for end-to-end confirmation.

V0.77 relaxes candidate promotion for explicit controller/ECU executable behavior via SW_BEHAVIOR_INFERRED_REVIEW_REQUIRED, but this is not approved software allocation and does not permit Official Release PASS before human review.
Tool Quality PASS does not imply Artifact Readiness PASS when external specifications, allocation decisions, or independent observability evidence are still missing.
Automated 3-AI consensus is an independent review aid and does not replace an approved Gold regression contract or required human approval.
A PARTIAL reviewer run preserves useful findings but is forced to Official Release HOLD.
When automatic evaluation is ON, the configured evidence package is transmitted to H-Chat or external provider APIs; organization/customer policy must permit that transmission.
Legacy V0.45 standard/duplicate/precise reviewer controls are intentionally retired; only the actual auto/manual/none evaluation contract remains.
Live Windows/H-Chat 3-provider evaluation was not executed in the build environment; V0.68 instead verifies persistence/failure behavior with deterministic mocked provider regression.
If a legacy external Requirement_Studio_Gold_Sources folder contains unexpected user files, V0.68 will not delete that folder automatically; it only stops future external writes.
REVIEW_NEEDED Semantic Units remain intentionally open until engineering linkage/disposition is resolved; V0.72 does not invent an owner, requirement, or allocation to close them.
V0.76 check_situation is a deterministic policy-impact diagnosis, not proof that every Pending item should become a SWE.1 software requirement or executable SWE.6 TC.
V0.77 intentionally changes only allocation-to-candidate promotion. Source-fidelity, unsupported-generation, exact-trace, conflict, visual-unknown and value-role safeguards remain protected.

Historical ESTRACK Canonical count V0.74=18 vs V0.76=15 has not been fully reconciled because the historical Review Package comparison was deferred; V0.77 does not claim this regression question is closed.

Contextual SRC-FRAGCTX-* aliases preserve claim context while retaining the original physical Source Fragment identity; human review may still decide that semantically distinct retry behaviors warrant independent source decomposition.
V0.79 Human Policy reuse is cross-document process guidance, not per-SRS official allocation approval. Inferred requirements remain review-required until engineering sign-off.
Same-PC cross-version persistence uses the external local registry. Moving only the ZIP to another PC starts from the package seed unless the external registry is also migrated.
V0.79 imports explicit edited GUIDE_PERSON checkbox decisions on the next Run; it does not interpret AI Suggested Position or an unmarked/multi-marked handoff as approval.

V0.81 Semantic ownership auto-cleanup is intentionally conservative: single-claim low-similarity traces and ambiguous/critical shared Source facts are not auto-deleted and may still require human review.

V0.82 integrated outputs preserve review/deferred/native verification intent but do not convert review artifacts into execution-ready tests or auto-approve SYS/SWE allocation; human decisions remain required.
V0.83 recommended Unified evaluation requires five actual engineer-facing artifacts; focused SWE.1/SWE.6 debug modes intentionally do not use that five-artifact contract.
for_h_chat Context Pack is curated and size-bounded; absence of code from the pack does not prove absence from the full program and the pack is not Source evidence.
V0.85 OPEN Semantic similarity suggestions and Mode Transition review findings are advisory/human-governed; they never auto-close Semantic Units or auto-change SYS/SWE allocation.

V0.85 per-finding Mode Transition decisions are persisted separately from Global Human Policy; users must import reviewed Integrated Test decisions or otherwise populate the external Review Decision Registry for reuse.
V0.86 code/regression validates E2E projections with synthetic fixtures; real MLM/ESTRACK or a new production Source should be rerun before Gold promotion.
E2E Evaluation intentionally keeps ambiguous Source-backed engineering facts as Human Review instead of silently dropping them; this can increase review workload but preserves no-silent-loss.

consensus_rules.cross_category_semantic_dedup: Equivalent findings may cluster across Category labels only when concrete affected IDs and a specific failure concept agree.

automated_evaluation.partial_reviewer_completion: PARTIAL; cannot independently declare Official Release PASS

final_result.completeness_audit: provider finding occurrences -> consensus mapping; unmapped must be 0

automated_evaluation.direct_api_key_storage: Environment variables only; secrets are not packaged.
automated_evaluation.provider_persistence: Each reviewer result is atomically written immediately when that reviewer finishes.
automated_evaluation.completion_contract: UI success only after required output files are verified on disk and non-zero.

gui_progress.semantics: stage-based workflow progress, not provider token progress

automated_evaluation.evidence_graph: Source + compact Trace Graph + SWE.1 Word/Excel + SWE.6 Excel + Integrated Requirements/Test actual-artifact snapshots + QA/regression/single-truth audit
automated_evaluation.unselected_artifact_absence_is_not_defec: true outside Unified required set; in recommended Unified mode the five contracted artifacts are mandatory
automated_evaluation.provenance_audit: single structured Source-fact token stream + separate critical Fact Fragment ownership gate
automated_evaluation.semantic_disposition: REVIEW_NEEDED is OPEN/non-terminal until linked or explicitly dispositioned
automated_evaluation.exact_fragment_ownership_rule: Union of all exact fragments linked to an SRS; reviewer must respect owned_fragment_fact_token_sources.
automated_evaluation.critical_fragment_completion: Explicitly cited Source-location bounded; literal missing-token evidence required.
automated_evaluation.open_review_needed_classification: Explicit OPEN/non-terminal REVIEW_NEEDED is Artifact Readiness/Release Governance unless silent drop/false close or separate trace loss is proven.
automated_evaluation.parent_containment: Respect deterministic Semantic Unit + Fact Fragment containment. Clear unrelated dominant-owner leakage may be removed; ambiguous/critical shared ownership remains review-required.

situation_check.policy: V0.83 reports Engineering Main/SYS/SWE/native projections plus integrated Test Object counts and evaluates the five-artifact Unified contract while retaining Human Policy reuse.
situation_check.deferred_intent_counting: Review Package summary and actual serialized SWE.6 3_Deferred Intent data-row count are cross-checked; title/header/placeholder rows are excluded.

guide_person.purpose: Reuse approved cross-document Human Policy and ask only new/DEFER policy families rather than repeated per-SRS questions.
guide_person.answer_persistence: Version-independent Human Policy Registry; package seed adds missing IDs only and never overwrites local decisions.
guide_person.snapshot: applied_policy_snapshot.txt/.json records the exact reused policies and remaining questions for each Run.
guide_person.human_decision_import: Edit generated guide_person_###.txt and mark exactly one checkbox; next Run imports it into the external Registry before policy resolution.
guide_person.import_safety: AI Suggested Position, blank selections, and multiple marked selections are never human approval.
guide_person.change_audit: Imported guide file SHA-256 and policy changes are recorded in persistent Registry metadata/change log.

automated_evaluation.v086_unified_artifact_contract: Legacy SWE.1/SWE.6 + E2E Requirements Word/Excel + E2E Evaluation Excel

evaluation.human_policy_handoff: GUIDE_PERSON candidate families + persistent external Human Policy Registry + per-Run applied policy snapshot
evaluation.human_policy_auto_application: YES/NO/CONDITIONAL stable policy decisions are reused within their registered scope; DEFER/new families remain questions. This is process-policy reuse, not per-SRS official allocation.
evaluation.review_preservation: REVIEW_REQUIRED/HOLD requirements remain visible in Main Requirement Specification and Review/Allocation views; visible != approved/released.
evaluation.human_policy_decision_ingestion: Explicit single-checkbox selections edited into prior guide_person_###.txt are imported on the next Run with source-file SHA/change audit.
evaluation.consensus_clustering: V0.82 retains V0.81 affected-ID + specific-failure-concept clustering and evaluates integrated-output/single-truth consistency.
evaluation.e2e_workbook_coverage: All E2E sheets/all nonempty rows; incomplete/truncated snapshot cannot claim COMPLETE.
evaluation.recommended_label: 통합 E2E 평가 (요구사항 + 평가 명세서, 추천)

package_layout.root_policy: Keep launcher/runtime files and only latest Requirements baseline rev72 in root; history/docs/policy live in subfolders.
package_layout.historical_deletion_policy: Preserve by default; do not auto-delete prior baselines/change decisions without explicit user instruction.
package_layout.human_policy_runtime_store: External version-independent user store: %LOCALAPPDATA%\RequirementStudio\human_policy on Windows, override/fallback documented.
package_layout.human_policy_feedback_loop: Generated GUIDE_PERSON TXT explicit checkbox -> next Run import -> external Registry -> repeat-question suppression.
package_layout.review_decision_runtime_store: External version-independent user store: %LOCALAPPDATA%\RequirementStudio\review_decisions on Windows; mode transition decisions keyed by stable MT-* finding ID.
